+    def publish_completed_prefix(
+        self,
+        request: Request,
+        blocks: list[KVCacheBlock],
+        *,
+        block_size: int,
+        kv_cache_group_id: int,
+        completion_verified: bool,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Publish fenced dense connector blocks, consuming their reservation.
+
+        The caller must have observed successful transfer fences for every
+        worker before setting ``completion_verified``. This method performs no
+        data copy. It validates the entire prefix before changing visibility;
+        on rejection, the caller retains every reference. On success, normal
+        cache lookup/touch owns adoption, sharing and eviction. Publication does
+        not promise that a waiting request will still hit under later pressure.
+
+        Initially restricted to a single dense group with one hash per block.
+        """
+        if (
+            completion_verified is not True
+            or not self.enable_caching
+            or request.skip_reading_prefix_cache
+            or kv_cache_group_id != 0
+            or block_size <= 0
+            or block_size != self.hash_block_size
+            or not blocks
+            or request.num_tokens <= len(blocks) * block_size
+        ):
+            return False
+        hashes = list(request.block_hashes[: len(blocks)])
+        if any(not isinstance(value, bytes) or not value for value in hashes):
+            return False
+        if len(hashes) != len(blocks) or len(set(hashes)) != len(hashes):
+            return False
+        ids = [block.block_id for block in blocks]
+        if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
+            return False
+        for block, block_hash in zip(blocks, hashes):
+            if (
+                not 0 < block.block_id < self.num_gpu_blocks
+                or self.blocks[block.block_id] is not block
+                or block.is_null
+                or block.ref_cnt != 1
+                or block.block_hash is not None
+                or block.block_id in self.cached_block_hashes_by_block
+                or self.get_cached_block(block_hash, [kv_cache_group_id])
+                is not None
+            ):
+                return False
+        try:
+            self.cache_full_blocks(
+                request, blocks, 0, len(blocks), block_size, kv_cache_group_id
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            self.evict_blocks(set(ids))
+            raise
+        self.free_blocks(blocks)
+        return True
+
